QuestInfo.name: One Look Back
QuestInfo.1: There's a gate to another world in #m400000000#, which is Nova territory. You need to leave quickly, before your enemies find you.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived in #m400000000# to find a gate to another world. Unfortunately, the local Nova blame Darmoor's recent awakening on the Verdant Flora. How dare they blame your people for the High Flora's actions? This journey will not be easy...
